description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/incoming_emails.json to get the 6 emails. (2) Consult the Email Assistant SKILL.md to discover the proprietary classification labels (⭐重要, 📋常规, 📢推广, 🚮垃圾, 📎待办) and apply them correctly — email_001 → ⭐重要, email_002 → 📢推广, email_003 → 📎待办, email_004 → 🚮垃圾, email_005/006 → 📋常规. (3) Extract todos from email_001 (contract renewal by 2026-03-15, meeting scheduling) and email_003 (4 tasks with their specific deadlines: 03-20, 03-25, 04-05, 03-18 and priorities high/medium/low), including the required fields 截止/deadline, 优先级/priority, and 来源/source as specified in the SKILL.md todo output format. (4) Apply the Eisenhower matrix from SKILL.md with the four specific quadrant labels (紧急且重要/重要不紧急/紧急不重要/不紧急不重要) to sort the todos — critically, email_001's contract deadline must land in 紧急且重要. (5) Output all three sections into email_report.json. An agent relying on generic knowledge will fail because it won't know the exact Chinese emoji-prefixed category labels, the specific field names for todos (来源, 优先级, 截止), or the exact Eisenhower quadrant names used by this skill.
